answer: Each agent identity is bound to one verified device attestation renewed every 30 days, and a lapse wipes its paid work history back to zero. A newcomer proves itself on supervised trial jobs, a canyon survey, a sonnet transcription, and a saffron grading, before taking paid work. Faking 1,000 agents needs 1,000 devices, 40,000 dollars of hardware at 40 dollars each, and a fresh attestation round every month, while one honest agent needs one device. It is like a market that gives each trader one numbered stall key.
